steps.js: (() => { if (document.querySelector('.hwp-app')?.dataset.phase !== 'ready') return false; const w = document.querySelector('.hwp-editor-host iframe')?.contentWindow; const a = w?.rhwpStudio?.automation; if (!a) return false; if (!w.__e2eCaretHome) { a.registerCommand({ id: 'ext:e2e-caret-home', label: 'E2E caret home', execute(services, result) { result.moved = services.getInputHandler()?.moveCursorTo({ sectionIndex: 0, paragraphIndex: 0, charOffset: 0 }) } }); w.__e2eCaretHome = true; } const result = {}; w.focus(); return a.execute('ext:e2e-caret-home', result).ok && result.moved === true && w.document.activeElement?.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' })()

(() => { const f = document.querySelector('.hwp-editor-host iframe'); let inner = null; try { const w = f && f.contentWindow; inner = f && { href: String(w.location.href), state: w.document.readyState, studio: typeof w.rhwpStudio, secure: w.isSecureContext, isolated: w.crossOriginIsolated, errors: w.__e2eErrors || [], text: w.document.body.innerText.slice(0, 200) } } catch (e) { inner = String(e) } return { host: !!document.querySelector('.hwp-editor-host'), iframes: document.querySelectorAll('iframe').length, secure: isSecureContext, errors: window.__e2eErrors || [], inner, html: document.body.innerHTML.slice(0, 400) } })()
